definitions.explanation: A mushroom that contains toxins harmful or fatal to humans when consumed.

examples.japanese: {毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please watch out for poisonous mushrooms.

examples.japanese: {毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{食用|しょくよう}→食用：25328_shokuyou⟧きのこ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見分|みわ}け→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Poisonous and edible mushrooms are hard to tell apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Every autumn, there are incidents of poisoning from eating toxic mushrooms.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧ (poison) + ⟦{茸|きのこ}→茸：04994_kinoko⟧ (mushroom). Also sometimes read as どくたけ. Japan has numerous species of poisonous wild mushrooms, making this a practical vocabulary word during mushroom-hunting season in autumn.

COMMON POISONOUS SPECIES IN JAPAN:
- ツキヨタケ: moon night mushroom — the most common cause of mushroom poisoning in Japan
- ドクツルタケ: destroying angel — one of the most deadly
- カエンタケ: fire mushroom — toxic even to touch

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be poisoned by a toxic mushroom
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧: to distinguish poisonous mushrooms
- {毒茸|どくきのこ}⟦{中毒|ちゅうどく}→中毒：16558_chuudoku⟧: mushroom poisoning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食用|しょくよう}→食用：25328_shokuyou⟧きのこ: edible mushroom — the safe counterpart
- きのこ{狩|が}り: mushroom hunting — the activity where knowledge of {毒茸|どくきのこ} matters
- ⟦{毒草|どくそう}→毒草：18118_dokusou⟧: poisonous plant — the broader plant category
